data.title: Luma Park Views
data.about:
Luma Park Views at JVC by TownX Development is an exquisite multi-storey residential complex featuring 4 podium levels, 20 residential floors, and a rooftop. The project offers luxury 1- to 3-bedroom apartments, catering to those seeking sophisticated living in Dubai.

Residents of Luma Park Views at JVC Dubai enjoy an array of top-tier amenities, including swimming pools, state-of-the-art gyms, and a serene internal garden for relaxation. Situated in the heart of Jumeirah Village Circle (JVC), Luma Park Views offers breathtaking vistas of lush parks and immaculate landscaping, offering a peaceful sanctuary within the dynamic urban landscape of Dubai.

characteristics_module.title: Luma Park Views - A Perfect Choice For a Family-friendly Lifestyle
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• Prime Location in JVC: Situated in a tranquil yet vibrant community, Luma Park Views at JVC by TownX Development offers easy access to major Dubai landmarks.
  • Luxurious Residential Options: Offers meticulously designed 1- to 3-bedroom apartments with high-quality finishes, combining elegance and functionality.
  • Exceptional Amenities: Features two spacious swimming pools, two state-of-the-art gyms, a jogging track, an internal garden, children’s play areas, and beautifully landscaped gardens.
  • Seamless Blend of Nature and Urban Living: Provides stunning views of lush green parks and landscaped grounds, creating a peaceful retreat within the bustling city.
  • Family-Friendly Environment: A safe and welcoming community with recreational areas and leisure spaces designed for families and individuals alike.
  • Secure and Convenient Living: Offers 24/7 security, CCTV surveillance, concierge services, and a semi-furnished setup for added convenience.

location_tile.title: Luma Park Views Prime Location in JVC
location_tile.heading: Location
location_tile.description:
Luma Park Views is strategically located in the heart of Jumeirah Village Circle (JVC), one of Dubai's most sought-after residential communities. JVC offers a perfect balance of tranquility and convenience, surrounded by lush green spaces and well-planned infrastructure. Residents enjoy easy access to key landmarks. Additionally, destinations such as Palm Jumeirah, Dubai Marina, and Skydive Dubai are within a short drive, making JVC a prime location for those seeking a peaceful retreat with excellent connectivity to the city's vibrant attractions.

  • Dubai Sports City - 5 minutes
  • Dubai Hills Mall - 7 minutes
  • Palm Jumeirah - 12 minutes
  • Dubai Marina - 10 minutes
  • Dubai International Airport - 25 minutes
